non_HTML_renderers.classification: Only local decorative-icons.ts inline SVG shapes found by explicit SVG/canvas/text-drawing source scan. SVG width/height/viewBox/path coordinates are geometry metadata, not displayed workload/date/percentage/capacity/runtime/comparison numeral text. No current canvas renderer, SVG text numeral renderer or font-feature override found in frontend/src TS. Actual analysis charts are HTML span/div bars with HTML numeric labels and HTML data tables.
non_HTML_renderers.scope_limit: Source scan of current TypeScript/HTML-emitting modules, not arbitrary extension/third-party/OS internals.

justified_boundaries.reason: Author CSS requests numeric features on actual input/select/option DOM. OS-rendered calendar/spinner/popup internals cannot be certified by DOM computed styles; no custom widget replacement or unsupported equal-width claim.

Computed tabular-nums is exact original31 verification target. Actual equal digit advances depend on installed/font fallback feature support. Existing families/stacks remain unchanged; no guarantee for every installed font or script.
No category numeral text renderer found outside current HTML; SVG icon coordinates are not operational numbers. No synthetic missing renderer invented as proof.
CSV/JSON/download/export content formatting is outside frontend typography and remains exact; no numeric source values transformed.

limitations: Source family inventory plus globally inherited policy is broader implementation evidence than a representative selector list. Actual computed probes cover every requested category, while route captures provide broad unchanged-value/layout support with frozen historical source bridge.
No exhaustive current-state record enumeration, all installed glyph measurements, all popup or all260 claim.
No ledger/test/product edits or browser execution by reviewer.
